department: School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences

deadline.value: Session 1 International Road to Research Scholarship applications close on 31 October 2026.
deadline.quote: International Road to Research Scholarship Monday 15 June 2026 Saturday 31 October 2026

also.quote: International Research Scholarship Round Monday 15 June 2026 Friday 31 July 2026

entry_route.value: Admission requires a Master of Research (MRes) with at least 75% in the second year, an MPhil, or a 2-year master's degree with a major research component at Distinction level (75% or greater).
entry_route.quote: In addition, you’ll need to meet one of the following requirements: a Master of Research (MRes) with at least 75 per cent in second year a Master of Philosophy a two-year master's degree with a major research component at Distinction level (75 per cent or greater).

supervisor.value: Applicants must find a supervisor and work with them to develop a research proposal prior to applying.
supervisor.quote: work with your proposed supervisor to develop a research proposal

funding.value: PhD candidates may be awarded competitive scholarships providing a tuition fee offset, living allowance stipend ($40,900 per annum in 2027), and OSHC.
funding.quote: PhD students may be eligible for scholarships that provide financial support during their three years of research, including a stipend valued at $40,900 per annum in 2027, indexed annually.

toefl_min.value: Schedule 1 requires TOEFL iBT 86 overall (18 reading, 21 writing, 17 listening, 21 speaking) for most Graduate Research courses.
toefl_min.quote: Competent English 86 18 21 17 21 Most Graduate Research courses

ielts_min.value: Schedule 1 requires IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with minimum 6.0 in each band for most Graduate Research courses.
ielts_min.quote: Competent English 6.5 6.0 6.0 6.0 6.0 Most Graduate Research courses

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is required or mentioned for research degree admission.

notes: Macquarie University offers the Doctor of Philosophy in School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences under centralized Graduate Research Academy admissions.
